description: July 2026 hybrid marketing-lift series. Historical period (2026-04-06 → training_end): lift = empirical Fenix Android gap (fresh no-mktg actuals − April mktg-off forecast). Future period (training_end+1 → 2026-12-31): lift anchored at the empirical level on training_end, growing per the July marketing-team CSV. Forward growth is driven by the '2026 DAU' acquisition-cohort column (campaign-attributable), NOT 'Total Paid DAU' — the latter's growth is cancelled by the declining Pre-2026 legacy cohort. Same recipe and pipeline as the June v2 build; only the CSV, the growth column, and training_end changed.

methodology.framing: hybrid: empirical-actuals for historical period, CSV-anchored projection for future
methodology.historical_rule: lift(d) = fenix_gap_daily(d) for d in [CAMPAIGN_LAUNCH, training_end]; 0 pre-campaign
methodology.future_rule: lift(d) = gap_at_training_end + (csv_daily_paid(d) − csv_daily_paid(training_end)) for d > training_end
methodology.week_anchor: Week 1 == 2026-01-05 (Monday); weekly Mondays linearly interpolated to daily

caveats: Historical lift = raw daily fenix_gap_daily — carries DOW noise and non-marketing April-forecast errors.
Future lift uses the July CSV's '2026 DAU' cohort growth; the Pre-2026 legacy decline is left to Prophet's base trend.
The world-rollup add-back is not strictly tight: curate_mozaics reconciliation leaves a ~10-20% residual; inspect the trial visually.
